title: The French president may dissolve the National Assembly after required consultations
summary: The French president may dissolve the National Assembly after required consultations.
body: Article 12 allows the president, after consulting the prime minister and the presidents of the houses, to dissolve the National Assembly, with a general election inside a stated window of days. The source says: "uses of Parliament, declare the National Assembly dissolved." Dissolution is a power written in the constitution, with a consultation step and a timing rule. It is not an extra-legal act in the text.

sources.title: Constitution of 4 October 1958, Constitute Project English text
